name: Shartegosuchus
isnote: PBDB places it in a shartegosuchid/shartegosuchoid group that has no clade entry in the atlas yet; placed in the nearest atlas ancestor.
sum: Shartegosuchus is a protosuchian-grade crocodyliform from Late Jurassic lake deposits of the Ulan Malgait Formation, Mongolia.
wsnote: The holotype is a juvenile, so no adult size is given.
holotype: PIN 4174/2, a partial deformed skull and jaws of a juvenile, Ulan Malgait Formation, Mongolia.
material: The holotype and further PBDB occurrences.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Efimov 1988
